vocabulary.definition: the maximum amount that something can contain
vocabulary.example: The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000 people.

vocabulary.definition: to make someone uncertain or unable to understand something
vocabulary.example: The complex instructions confused the new employees.

vocabulary.definition: a short stay in a journey to rest or visit a place briefly
vocabulary.example: Our flight to Paris had a stopover in Frankfurt.

vocabulary.definition: something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss or suffering
vocabulary.example: She received compensation for the damage caused to her car.

vocabulary.definition: a formal examination of evidence before a judge and typically before a jury
vocabulary.example: The suspect will stand trial for the robbery next week.

vocabulary.definition: a person who favors the abolition of a practice or institution, especially slavery
vocabulary.example: The Abolitionist Movement fought against the inhumane practice of slavery.
